channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: UK joins European push for low-cost air defence weapons
item.description: The UK has joined France, Germany, Italy and Poland in launching a new multinational initiative to develop low-cost air defence weapons aimed at countering drone and missile threats across Europe. The post UK joins European push for low-cost air defence weapons first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: American and Estonian divers train under ice in Baltic
item.description: U.S. Navy Seabee divers and Estonian counterparts have conducted ice diving and underwater demolition training in Estonia. The post American and Estonian divers train under ice in Baltic first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: L3Harris wins major submarine comms contract
item.description: L3Harris Technologies has secured its largest full-rate production contract for U.S. Navy submarine communications systems. The post L3Harris wins major submarine comms contract first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Trial helps accelerate next gen atomic clock for UK military
item.description: A trial led by the Defence Science and Technology Laboratory (Dstl) has supported the development of next-generation atomic clock tech. The post Trial helps accelerate next gen atomic clock for UK military first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: First Minister visits Babcock frigate yard at Rosyth
item.description: John Swinney, the First Minister of Scotland, has visited Babcock's Rosyth yard to see first hand how work on the Royal Navy Type 31 frigates is progressing and to underline the importance of naval shipbuilding to Scotland's economy. The post First Minister visits Babcock frigate yard at Rosyth first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: How U.S. Navy F-16 jets support adversary training
item.description: The aircraft form part of a broader adversary enterprise that includes other platforms used to replicate a range of air threats. The post How U.S. Navy F-16 jets support adversary training first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Most powerful warship in the world heading to Iran
item.description: The U.S. Navy's newest aircraft carrier, USS Gerald R. Ford, has transited the Strait of Gibraltar and is heading east. The post Most powerful warship in the world heading to Iran first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Scotland sends 280 tonnes of anti-drone nets to Ukraine
item.description: More than 280 tonnes of used fishing nets from Scotland will be sent to Ukraine to help counter Russian drone attacks, the Scottish Government has announced. The post Scotland sends 280 tonnes of anti-drone nets to Ukraine first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Images show huge new British warship ahead of sea trials
item.description: New images of HMS Glasgow show the Royal Navy's first Type 26 frigate taking shape on the Clyde as the 8,000-tonne warship moves closer to sea trials. The post Images show huge new British warship ahead of sea trials first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Denmark evacuates sailor from US attack sub off Greenland
item.description: Danish Arctic Command has carried out a medical evacuation from a U.S. Navy nuclear-powered attack submarine operating near Greenland. The post Denmark evacuates sailor from US attack sub off Greenland first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
